response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total_executions AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM orderexecutions), shares AS (SELECT ec.ordersmark, ec.exec_count, CAST(ec.exec_count AS REAL) / te.total_count as share FROM execution_counts ec CROSS JOIN total_executions te), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), with_difference AS (SELECT s.ordersmark, s.exec_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share as share_diff FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a) SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share_diff FROM with_difference ORDER BY CASE WHEN ordersmark IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, share_diff DESC LIMIT 10
